name: Owner
description: The RedLeaf user who configured Mail. Only this user and their bound agent can use it.

name: Bound Agent
description: Agent entity id that may read mail for the owner and receives Mail context and LIVE notices.

name: OAuth Client ID
description: Google Desktop app OAuth client id. Encrypted and never returned over HTTP.

name: OAuth Client Secret
description: Google Desktop app OAuth client secret. Encrypted and never returned over HTTP.

name: LIVE New-Mail Notices
description: Post a quoted sender + subject notice to the owner's confidential LIVE for new Inbox mail.

name: LIVE Excluded Categories
description: Gmail category labels that never produce LIVE notices. Default: promotions, social, forums.

name: Email
description: Mailbox address reported by Gmail after consent.

name: Refresh Token
description: Google OAuth refresh token (gmail.readonly). Encrypted, never returned over HTTP, never logged.

name: History ID
description: Gmail history cursor for incremental sync.

name: Last Error
description: Human-readable; never contains token material or Google response bodies.

name: Health Epoch
description: Counts health transitions so each LIVE health notice has a distinct idempotency key.
